Lead source.observedAtUTC and dedupe.checkedAtUTC are local +08:00 times labelled Z. The corrected UTC values are local minus 8h. Even corrected, both still postdate the commit by about 11 min, so they were also rounded or estimated. The real observation time is therefore no later than the lead's committing commit (2026-10-28T18:18:40Z). The lead bytes are left unchanged because their digest is bound into the request/receipt/meta record. This is why gaia dev frontier lead-validate fails for this lead (future timestamp; later than the committing commit). Recorded by the Meta verifier (declared, unauthenticated).
